provenance: Rig, bone names, bind pose and clips: Actor_B. Body and outfit geometry: tools/character/build_body.py. Weapon models: tools/models.
conventions: rig space at null-add; angles 0 front / 90 right / 180 back / 270 left around the torso axis; radial band measured from the legacy outer surface (data/loadout/body_fit.json outer_surface); follows_bone = the bone the zone moves with
layer: stowed weapons sit on layer 65 (above belts 60, below hair 70); a zone is kept free of layer >= 50 items that would sit on or through the stowed item
bulk_rule: for outfits with more bulk than the legacy coat the whole zone moves out by bulk(outfit, region) - bulk(legacy, region) (body_fit.json outfit_bulk)

zones.purpose: belt pistol at the right hip (source no-pack draw target)
rules: No accessory may hang or bulge here: no pouch, horn, cartridge box, sash ends, knife or fringe.
Belts and sashes pass through at y 0.92-1.06 only (the pistol hooks or tucks on them).
Coat skirts may lie under it (cloth); fur pile under it flattens (customizer_design.md 9.4).
zones.note: br_belts_cartridge's box violates this zone: with the cross belts the pistol moves to L_hip / chest hook.

zones.purpose: tomahawk / atlatl through the belt at the back, knife behind the left hip
rules: Leave free of pouches, blanket rolls and tumplines hanging below the belt.
The knot of belt_tied_behind sits at 175-185 deg: the back point moves to 200 deg (see survey).

zones.purpose: second pistol (cross draw) / hanger frog / knife in front of the shot pouch
rules: The shot pouch must hang at or behind 285 deg (today 240-285: it may not move forward).
Sash knots and ends tied at the left hip block this zone (sash gear lists no L_hip point).

zones.purpose: powder horn behind and below the right arm
rules: Keep capes, blanket folds and tumplines from filling this band; the horn strap comes over the left shoulder.
A wrap (blanket, fur mantle) over it pushes it out by the wrap bulk; the horn stays outside the wrap.

zones.purpose: long_A / long_B slung weapons and the quiver
rules: No hard accessories on the back between the shoulder blades and the buttocks (blanket rolls, knapsacks, tumpline loads) while long weapons are slung; a tumpline blanket roll replaces a long slot.
Wraps and fur mantles raise the slot by their back bulk (outfit_bulk).

zones.purpose: long weapons pass behind and above both shoulders; quiver nocks behind the right shoulder
rules: Hats: brims and plumes must clear lines from (+-0.10, 1.42, -0.18) up to (+-0.5, 2.3, -0.10); tricorn back corners are the risk.
Hair queues / braids lie under the slung items (they are pendulums on wrinklemaps).

zones.purpose: pistols hung on the pistol sling
rules: Only while the pistol sling is worn: gorgets, brooches and kerchief ends must stay above y 1.30 or under the pistols.

zones.purpose: pistol through the sash at the front left
rules: Only with a sash: aprons and breechcloth fronts lie under it.
